corrections.reason: The preposition prefix በ- in በልማዱ ('according to His custom') was misread as ል due to slight narrowing at the top of the Fidel በ.
Both visually (shortened right leg on ካ) and grammatically (ከ + አዘጋጁት -> ካዘጋጁት, matching the parallel ካዘጋጁት on line 11), the printed character is 4th-order ካ.
The 3rd-order Fidel ዲ in እንዲሆን was misread as 5th-order ዴ due to ink fill on the right leg.
The classic Andemta idiom 'ወልውለው ሰንግለው ከብተው እንዲያኖሩት' (from ከበተ, to store/treasure) is printed as ከብተው; ink bleed at the base of ተ caused it to be misread as ቷ and ከ as ክ.
